title: Asian Family with Basset Hound by Tree, 1962 B&W Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A mid-century black-and-white snapshot taken in February 1962 capturing an Asian-American family in their cozy living room. The mother, wearing a refined dress with a decorative brooch, kneels beside her young child holding a holiday ornament, while the father poses proudly next to their pet Basset Hound. Behind them stands a stylish white artificial tree popular during the 1960s, set beside a white brick fireplace hearth.
